P01.name: Lower handle shell
P01.detail: Battery saddles, board supports, six M3 insert seats. Insert fit requires test coupon.

P02.name: Upper handle shell
P02.detail: OLED pod, button opening, six recessed M3 screw channels.

P03.name: ESP32 controller tray
P03.detail: 52 x 28 x 12 mm reference board; strap slots, no fictitious mounting holes.

P06.name: Connector panel insert
P06.detail: 2 mm panel with manufacturer-profile opening for Molex 43020-0600. Two M2 screws. Print coupon and check actual connector latches.

P07.name: Filament head body
P07.detail: 102 mm mechanism chamber; servo, 3-position nylon carrier, guide and optical travel gate. Index only with probe fully withdrawn.

P08.name: Filament front cap
P08.detail: Probe guide and TCST2103 mounts. Sensor screw centers 19 mm apart. Front guide removable with two M2 screws.

P09.name: SG90 strap cradle
P09.detail: Tie SG90 into open adjustable cradle with two 2.5 mm straps. Align output shaft with X-axis using stock horn; do not print a spline.

P11.name: Vibration dome cap
P11.detail: Adafruit 1201 coin motor (10 x 2.7 mm), adhesive retained. Prototype dome must be physically assessed for vibration transfer.

P12.name: Response button cap
P12.detail: 0.3 mm nominal switch gap; set final switch height with thin shims.

P13.name: Fastener fit coupon
P13.detail: Left to right: 3.2 / 3.4 / 3.9 / 4.1 mm bores. Use before full enclosure print.

P14.name: Handle wire clamp
P14.detail: M2 screw clamp over 4.8 mm bore; 4.2 mm diameter bundle reserve. Optional soft liner adapted to the real wires.

P15.name: Male joint fit coupon
P15.detail: Exact pilot and key geometry from both heads. Use with each female fit coupon.

P16.name: Female fit coupon / 0.25 mm
P16.detail: Radial clearance 0.25 mm against current male. Same keyway as full handle.

P17.name: Female fit coupon / 0.35 mm
P17.detail: Radial clearance 0.35 mm against current male. Same keyway as full handle.

P18.name: Female fit coupon / 0.45 mm
P18.detail: Radial clearance 0.45 mm against current male. Same keyway as full handle.

P19.name: Connector panel fit coupon
P19.detail: Actual 2 mm connector insert rotated flat, for checking the connector snap-in fit before printing housing.

P20.name: Boost converter shelf
P20.detail: U3V40F5 strap platform. Four M2 screws into SD shelf columns; remove for SD access.

P21.name: Three-position carrier
P21.detail: Three cartridge pockets spaced 60 degrees on R10. Carrier travel -60 / 0 / +60 degrees. Stock SG90 horn in rear pocket, two M2 screws in radial slots.

P22.name: Nylon cartridge 1
P22.detail: 1.3 mm potting bore. Bond independently calibrated nylon; trim free length to 38 mm for this mechanical build. Diameters are calibration variables, not a force guarantee.

P23.name: Nylon cartridge 2
P23.detail: 1.3 mm potting bore. Bond independently calibrated nylon; trim free length to 38 mm for this mechanical build. Diameters are calibration variables, not a force guarantee.

P24.name: Nylon cartridge 3
P24.detail: 1.3 mm potting bore. Bond independently calibrated nylon; trim free length to 38 mm for this mechanical build. Diameters are calibration variables, not a force guarantee.

P25.name: Cartridge retainer
P25.detail: Two M2 screws at Y +/-14, Z5 retain the three potted inserts without clamping the free nylon.

P26.name: Probe rear pad + optical flag
P26.detail: Low-mass pad with integral optical flag. Bond onto 3 mm polished shaft; 1 mm initial gap. No return spring: pull tip collar to fully extend before indexing.

P27.name: Probe guide flange
P27.detail: Seat for PTFE tube OD4/ID3.2, length7.5. Two M2 screws hold flange. Fit must slide freely; measure breakaway force.

P28.name: Rounded probe contact tip
P28.detail: Removable prototype contact tip; bond to rod. Guide flange gives 6 mm travel stop. Bench use pending surface and force verification.

P29.name: Tactile switch platform
P29.detail: 6 mm tactile switch mounted centrally. Two M2 mounting screws. Shim switch to give 0.3 mm cap travel.

P30.name: OLED retaining frame
P30.detail: Rear retaining frame with thin foam/adhesive at PCB corners. Remove upper shell as a module with display, frame and button cap.

P31.name: Battery protection tray
P31.detail: Strap or adhesive mount for 1S protection board, 16 x 12 x 5 max. Specify at least 5 A discharge rating; physical sample required.

H05.name: 1S battery protection board
H05.detail: Max. 16 x 12 x 5 mm; specify >=5 A

H07.name: microSD SPI breakout
H07.detail: 3.3 V module; max. 24 x 25 x 5 mm

H12.name: Supplied SG90 servo horn
H12.detail: Retain original spline and centre screw

H20.name: Motor driver board
H20.detail: Custom MOSFET board; 20 x 10 x 6 mm

H21.name: Head retaining screws
H21.detail: Two M3 x 8; one may be hidden

F01.name: USB-C charging opening
F01.detail: Opening in the lower handle shell

F02.name: Head alignment key
F02.detail: Integral printed feature of each head

F03.name: Handle pilot receiver rim
F03.detail: Integral part of the lower handle shell
